prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Beijing for a few days, and I remember just wandering around and talking about all the attractions there the whole time.
On that same trip, I was also chatting with coworkers about hotels in Beijing, since everyone seemed to have stayed in a different area.
After Beijing, I ended up taking the train down to Shanghai—kind of a blur now, but yeah, it was Beijing to Shanghai.
For the sightseeing day, we actually got tickets for the Forbidden City, for the morning slot on 2025-05-18.
The tickets were under Noah Wilson, and it was for 3 people total—family trip vibes.
Earlier that month, my friend Olivia Brown stayed at the Grand Mercure Beijing—she checked in on 2025-05-06 and only did 2 nights.
And for that Beijing-to-Shanghai leg, the ticket I remember was train D321 on 2025-04-22—Liu Yang had it in Second Class.
